title: DeepEra: A Deep Evidence Reranking Agent for Scientific Retrieval-Augmented Generated Question Answering
authors: Haotian Chen; Qingqing Long; Siyu Pu; Xiao Luo; Wei Ju; Meng Xiao; Yuanchun Zhou; Jianghua Zhao; Xuezhi Wang
why_relevant: Proposes a reranking agent and benchmark (SciRAG-SSLI) specifically targeting semantically similar but logically irrelevant distractor passages in RAG, directly addressing noisy retrieval and distraction robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on scientific QA domain; reranking-centric rather than full robustness taxonomy.
